rule.base: V12 news direction, surprise threshold, 15-minute confirmation, ATR ceiling, 1 ATR stop, 2 stop-distance target, 72-hour hold
rule.challenger: maximum executable spread divided by stop distance
rule.developmentGate: n>=20, win>=40%, expectancy>0, PF>1; select highest expectancy

v18NewsEntryLadder.objective: at least 100 executable entries per yearly period and >=45% wins in each while retaining +1.5R/-0.75R
v18NewsEntryLadder.mechanism: one news opportunity may create distinct entries at selected completed-candle delays; every entry has its own executable bid/ask fill, stop, target, and 72-hour path resolution
v18NewsEntryLadder.warning: entry count is not independent opportunity count; positions from one release are correlated and portfolio risk must be capped by event

v17NewsPlusSessionTechnical.objective: approximately 100 EUR/USD trades per yearly period while retaining >=45% wins, positive expectancy, and PF>1 in each exposed period
v17NewsPlusSessionTechnical.complementaryLane: one fixed UTC session decision per market day; past-only 1h/2h/4h/8h price move; momentum or mean-reversion direction; next-M5 executable bid/ask entry; ATR stop; 2:1 target; 72h maximum hold

v16HundredTradesPerYear.objective: >=100 trades in each yearly period and >=45% wins in each, with +1.5R/-0.75R, positive expectancy, and PF>1
v16HundredTradesPerYear.mechanism: all high-impact EUR/USD calendar releases; direction is the sign of a completed post-release candle; entry is the next M5 open; stop is max(pre-release ATR, configured share of observed post-release range)

v15FrequencyExpansion.objective: increase resolved trade count above 35 while maintaining at least the current combined 16/35 (45.71%) win rate, with win>=40%, positive expectancy, and PF>1 in each exposed yearly period
v15FrequencyExpansion.fixedExecution: conditional DOWN weak-surprise post-release-range stop; 2:1 target-to-stop; +1.5R/-0.75R; executable OANDA bid/ask; 72-hour maximum hold

highestFrequencyAcrossExposedPeriods.warning: chosen after both periods were exposed; descriptive only and requires a new prospective sample

v14EntryStopChallenger.selectionRule: entered>=12; preserve>=80% of baseline winners; totalR above baseline; win>=40%; PF>1; maximize development totalR

v14OneRetryChallenger.mechanism: leave baseline winners untouched; after a real stop, permit one same-direction retry only after a completed M5 close reclaims a predeclared level; enter next M5 open
v14OneRetryChallenger.selectionRule: preserve every baseline winner; totalR above baseline; win rate no lower than baseline; PF>1; maximize development totalR

v14ConditionalExecutionChallenger.mechanism: keep the baseline rule except on an observable weak subset, where a predeclared wider execution geometry is applied
v14ConditionalExecutionChallenger.selectionRule: enter every opportunity; preserve>=80% of baseline winners; totalR above baseline; win>=40%; PF>1; maximize development totalR
